summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for merchant provisioning and POS public API contracts on preview URL. All requested flows passed: admin provision kiosk bundle with API key creation, API-key auth to /public/v1/me, payment-flow documentation response, admin merchant feature UI selector visibility, feature toggle + price override regression, and admin login regression (.com rejected, .ae accepted).

integration_issues.issue: Console still logs unrelated 401/404 network errors on homepage load; target admin merchant-features flow itself remained functional.

action_items: Optional observability cleanup: remove/fix unrelated homepage API calls causing 401/404 console noise.
Keep current provisioning contract stable: /api/pos/features/admin/provision-merchant should continue returning one-time bbsec_ key_secret when create_api_key=true.
critical_code_review_comments: Role-check drift risk still exists across POS modules: pos_features._is_admin accepts only admin/superadmin, while other modules historically accepted additional admin-style roles. Align role checks centrally to avoid authorization mismatch.
AdminProvisionRequest.mode is free-form string; invalid values silently behave like merge. Add explicit enum/pattern validation to prevent accidental wrong-mode provisioning.
test_credentials: Used from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@bidblitz.ae / BidBlitz2026!, admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! (expected fail), merchant target MER-12DA5FAE925F.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression test file added for provisioning/public API. UI smoke validated merchant-provision-select presence and interactivity of loyalty toggle + price fields on /admin/merchant-features.
rca of the issue: No blocking defect reproduced in requested scope. Remaining console 401/404 noise appears outside tested merchant-provisioning contracts.
